_meanings:
<ab>N.</ab> of a son of Bhīma by a female demon named {#hiqimbA#};
 <ls>Bhāg. 9. 22. 30</ls>- 31. He was a very powerful person and fought valiantly
 in the great war

 between the Pāṇḍavas and Kauravas on the side of the former, but was
 slain by Karṇa with the Śakti or missile he had received from Indra;
 <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Mu. 2. 15</ls>. The derivation of the name is given in the {#Adiparva#}
 of {#mahABArata#} as follows: {#Gawo hAsyotkaca iti mAtA taM pratyaBAzata .#}
 {#abravIttena nAmAsya Gawotkaca iti sma ha ..#} <ls>Mb. 1. 155. 38</ls>.
